text: Vietnam's agro-forestry-fishery exports were estimated at $6.93 billion in October 2026, up 7.9% from the previous month and 13.4% year on year, according to a report by the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment.
Cumulative export revenue for the first 10 months reached approximately $63.02 billion, an increase of 8% compared with the same period last year.
Agricultural products remained the largest export category, generating $32.65 billion, up 3.9%.
Forestry products brought in $16.13 billion, up 7.3%, while seafood exports reached $10.44 billion, an increase of 11.7%.
China remained Vietnam's largest market for agro-forestry-fishery products, accounting for 25.1% of total exports.
The United States ranked second with a 19.9% share, followed by Japan at 7.3%.
During the 10-month period, exports to China rose 19% year on year, while shipments to the US and Japan increased by 1% and 4.8%, respectively.
Fruit and vegetables continued to be a bright spot among agricultural exports.
Their export value reached $8.32 billion in the first 10 months of 2026, up 17.8% from the same period in 2025.
October exports alone were estimated at $1.05 billion.
